description: List an event's registrations — Tito's orders — newest first, with buyer name/email, reference, total, state, paid/refunded flags, discount code and ticket quantities. Filter by free text (email, name, slug, reference, company, discount code), state, and created/updated time. Cancelled ones are excluded unless states includes 'cancelled'. Tito: GET /:account/:event/registrations.

account_slug.description: The account slug (the first part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>). Optional if TITO_ACCOUNT is set; tito_whoami lists the accounts this token can reach.

created_after.description: Only registrations created after this time (search[created_at][gt]), e.g. 2026-01-01T09:00:00+UTC. Without the +UTC suffix Tito uses the event's own time zone.

created_before.description: Only registrations created before this time (search[created_at][lt]), e.g. 2026-01-01T09:00:00+UTC. Without the +UTC suffix Tito uses the event's own time zone.

event_slug.description: The event slug (the second part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>), e.g. 2026.

page_size.description: Results per page (page[size]), 1-1000. Tito's default is 100.

q.description: Free-text search: email, name, slug, reference, company name or discount code.

sort.description: Sort attribute (search[sort]). Default created_at, newest first.

updated_after.description: Only registrations updated after this time (search[updated_at][gt]), e.g. 2026-01-01T09:00:00+UTC. Without the +UTC suffix Tito uses the event's own time zone.

view.description: Response view. Lists default to 'short'; 'extended' includes associated records but can be slow and large.

name: tito_list_registrations
title: List registrations (orders)
